parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* true (default): Use coupons.
* false: Do not use coupons.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go

- **Prepaid**: subscription

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The subscription type of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **Year**: yearly subscription

- **Month**: monthly subscription

> This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

- If **Period** is set to **Year**, set **UsedTime** to a value from 1 to 3.

- If **Period** is set to **Month**, set **UsedTime** to a value from 1 to 9.

> This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.
